💖 FINAL DONATION UPDATE – NOVEMBER 20, 2025 💖

Hello, OhmPoon PH family! This is the last update for this donation drive, and we are officially closing it. 🥰

Thanks to everyone who contributed, we’ve reached ₱18,328, and your generosity has made a real difference. 💖 While we may not have fully reached our goal, the overall total still accommodates all the latest support, and the remaining funds from this drive will be forwarded to Poon’s Birthday Party Project, managed by his official FC, to help make his celebration extra special. 🎂💙

We truly appreciate every single donation — your support has helped us bring our projects to life and share our love for Ohm & Poon in meaningful ways. 🌟

✨ Next Steps: Today, we will be dropping the details for two new separate donation drives:
1️⃣ Poon’s Birthday Gift Project – Let’s make his day unforgettable! 🎁
2️⃣ MRS Food Support Project – Continuing to spread care and love in support of our boys. 💌

💌 Thank you to all our donors, including those who prefer to remain anonymous — your support means so much and has helped make this drive a success.

📌 Donation Breakdown: The full breakdown for this drive will be posted at the end of the month.

Stay tuned for details on how to donate the new drives! Thank you again for being part of this journey and for your continued support. 💖

#ProjectOP_LoveInAction #OhmPoonPH #OhmPoon #โอห์มปูน #OhmThitiwat #poon_mit12

data.raw_text:
YSRCP Fans Crowd Begumpet Airport To Welcome President YS Jagan | Traffic Advisory Issued 

Massive crowds, mostly YRS Congress Party fans gathered at Hyderabad’s Begumpet Airport to welcome Andhra Pradesh’s former chief minister and the party president, YS Jagan Mohan Reddy, on Thursday, November 20. YS Jagan will be appearing in the Nampally ACB court today in the disproportionate assets case. Moderate traffic congestion is expected in the surrounding areas of Nampally Court; accordingly, traffic diversions are made for commuters' convenience.
